description: Search X (Twitter) using Desearch AI. Optional filters narrow by user, date, language, verification, media, and engagement. Sort stays Top.

count.description: Number of search results to return (default: 20), max is 100

end_date.description: End date in UTC (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with start_date.

is_quote.description: Include only posts that are quotes.

query.description: Twitter advanced search query, example: 'from:elonmusk since:2023-01-01 min_replies:10'

start_date.description: Start date in UTC (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with end_date.

name: x-search
title: X Search
